translations.web: My beloved thrust his hand in through the latch opening. My heart pounded for him.
translations.bsb: My beloved put his hand to the latch; my heart pounded for him.
translations.kjv: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, and my bowels were moved
translations.asv: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, And my heart was moved for him.
